texts.zh:
我们在方舟舰[Root.GetName]上的仪器记录到了来自[solar_system.GetName]星系黑洞的异常辐射。远距离扫描捕捉到一个不明物体正接近奇点。那艘巨大的舰船发出的技术信号远超我们的理解，干扰了我们的读数，导致无法进行精确分析。视觉确认也极其短暂，与其说是实物，倒不如说更像是一场幻觉。

在那艘船进入未知领域的前一刻，我们观察到了一个诡异的景象：船只完好无损地穿过了黑洞，且显然是有意为之。随后，所有信号都消失了。该船是被摧毁了、位移了，还是以某种无法理解的状态幸存下来，仍然不得而知。可以确定的是，黑洞产生了反应，而我们可能瞥见了一些尚无法解释的东西。无论在那道视界线上发生了什么，显而易见的是，这次观测并非没有带给我们任何改变。
texts.en:
Our instruments aboard the Arkship [Root.GetName] registered anomalous emissions from the black hole in the [solar_system.GetName] system. Long-range scans detected the glimpse of an unidentified object approaching the singularity. Their immense vessel emitted technological signatures far beyond our understanding, interfering with our readings and rendering precise analysis impossible. Visual confirmation was fleeting at best, resembling a hallucination more than anything tangible.

Moments before the vessel crossed into the unknown, we observe a strange sight: the ship passing through the black hole intact, clearly intentionally. Then, all signals ceased. Whether the vessel was destroyed, displaced, or survived in some incomprehensible state remains unknown. What is certain is that the black hole reacted, and we may have glimpsed something we cannot yet explain. Whatever transpired at that horizon, it is clear that we have not emerged from this observation unchanged.

summary.text:
# 黑洞现象 / Black Hole Phenomenon

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/nomads_arkship_events.txt、common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt、common/special_projects/06_projects_nomads.txt、common/event_chains/00_event_chains_nomads.txt · 游牧帝国内容 nomad content · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

游牧帝国的方舟随机事件：隐藏事件 arkship.1（nomads_arkship_events.txt:7-49）定期检查，游戏前5年不会发生，每次约三分之一几率（中期前×1.5；近期参战或所有方舟都在战斗时为0）调用 generate_arkship_event 从 mobile_arkship_random_events 池（00_on_actions.txt:3979-4006，24项，总权重460）中抽取一件，否则3–5年后再试。多数事件设置一次性标记（个别如“出发！”可发生两次）；结束后约10–15年再重新开始检查。（池中权重 20/460，00_on_actions.txt:3996）
Nomad arkship random event: hidden arkship.1 (nomads_arkship_events.txt:7-49) checks periodically — never in the first 5 years, about one in three (×1.5 before mid game, 0 during recent war or when every arkship is fighting) — and draws one episode from mobile_arkship_random_events (00_on_actions.txt:3979-4006, 24 entries, total weight 460); otherwise it retries in 3–5 years. Most episodes set a once-only flag (Start Your Engines can happen twice); after it ends the loop resumes roughly 10–15 years later. (pool weight 20/460, 00_on_actions.txt:3996)

条件：方舟所在星系有黑洞；未经历“永恒合唱”；只发生一次。
Conditions: a black hole in the system; not after The Eternal Chorus; once.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 黑洞发出异常辐射，远程扫描瞥见一个不明物体：继续观测，或收集能收集的。单篇事件。
  Anomalous emissions from the black hole: look further, or gather what we can. Single event.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 无后续；若之后发生“遥远回声”，其正文会提到此事。
  No follow-ups; A Distant Signal later references it.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无特殊差异。
  No notable variants.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：方舟事件循环 arkship.1 与随机池权重、本事件的触发条件与一次性标记、各选项的后续事件/项目与随机权重、延迟（@extremely_short_arkship_event_delay_days = 180 天，10_scripted_variables_nomads.txt:457）。
  Checked the arkship loop and pool weights, this episode's trigger and once-flag, options, projects, random weights and delays (180 days base).
- 说明 Note：地图上的延迟显示为未解析的脚本变量名，实际值见上（编译器请求）。
  Map delays show unresolved script variables; values are given above.
